about: The reckoning of days in Imbar (src/campaign/calendar.ts reads it): twelve months of thirty days, three to a season, beginning with the thaw; the sennight's days in the Common tongue's names; and the era the annals count. As data, not code, so that a setting of its own could keep another (BX-01's L3).
era: year of the Sun and Moon

begins.about: When a new life's year begins (the owner, 24 November: "we could even start the game with the transition from summer to fall"; OR-447): on the last day of summer, so that the year turns into autumn on its first night. The year itself is the world's own draw.
